text_block_list.text: While searching for Taiki Shuttle, who didn't come to training—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~! I found youuu~!
Come on, let's dash on over~!
choice_data_list: I was looking for you too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!! Is that telepathy!?
Talk about being on the exact same wavelength!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's head towards the goal together!

And I chased after her
as she dashed away...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Tai-chan, you're amazing!
First place again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~n, leave it to me!
I won't even lose a scavenger hunt!
choice_data_list: So you were slacking off on practice and playing around...!
So you were slacking off on practice and playing around...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hawaah!? Trainer!?
Your face looks scary, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, even if it's just for fun, it's still a match, you know?
So the desire to win is... right?

“—By the way, it turns out Taiki Shuttle's prompt
for the scavenger hunt was 'someone I'm grateful to.'”

...I decided to cut the lecture short
by just a tiny bit.
